purpose: Art Nouveau dashboard concept exploration; illustrative sample data; not deployed

concepts.name: Botanical Salon
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate a polished raster concept screenshot for an actual Home Assistant home dashboard themed in ART NOUVEAU circa 1900, adapted to a useful contemporary touch UI. Landscape 1536x1024. Flat front-facing screen, no device bezel, no perspective, no room photograph, no browser chrome, no watermark. This is a design exploration with illustrative sample states, not a live dashboard. Authentic organic whiplash curves, botanical tendrils and elegant asymmetrical plant forms; avoid Art Deco stepped geometry, sunbursts, geometric fans and angular chevrons. Keep ornamental accents at card borders, separators and header; keep readable control surfaces uncluttered. Large legible labels, sophisticated typography, restrained hierarchy, clear on/off indicators, comfortable touch targets.
Use consistent content across concepts. A slender top navigation with Home (active), Floor Plan, Media, Yard, Alexandria. A hero/header titled "Home" with a modest theme dropdown in upper right. Below: Scenes with four buttons "Living room on", "Good night", "All lamps off", "Pause music"; Now Playing with album artwork and play/pause/skip/volume controls; Climate card with circular thermostat and sample value 68°F. Lower half: Living Room card with Couch, Chez Lounge, Pappasan, Window and Grow lamp controls; Library card with Torch front, Torch back, Fireplace and Speaker; Outside card with Outdoor 1, Outdoor 2 and Sunset schedule; Workshop card with a small 3D-printer thumbnail, "Icarus" and a simple progress bar. Use grid-aligned rectangular or softly curved panels, not an illegible decorative poster. Clear interface, artistry expressed in framing and typography. Include a small concept title at bottom.
CONCEPT A — BOTANICAL SALON. Bright airy ivory parchment, sage green, muted olive, aged bronze with subtle dusty rose accents. Gentle hand-drawn iris stems and sinuous poppy leaves frame the header, delicate ink-like ornament across panel corners. Inspired by elegant Art Nouveau botanical book design, creamy matte surfaces, minimal texture, no distressed stains. Decorative serif for headings and clean sans-serif for control labels. Light background and generous breathing room. Theme dropdown reads "Botanical Salon ▾". Footer reads "A · Botanical Salon". Produce one complete dashboard concept.
